segments.text: Ok so, this is the chat components page in the CopilotKit docs, for Vue with Google Antigravity. It's linked from the quickstart, and I tried to implement this page.
So the only frontend code here is a React page dot tsx, umm, with the CopilotKit React component.
And the Python agent imports build from agents underscore common, which is never shown.

So basically this is the Vue page, but the code is React and Next JS. No Vue template, no CopilotKit provider, and uh, the suggestions hook isn't even imported. So there's nothing a Vue developer can actually build from it.
That's the problem here, please have a look.
